retrievalProfile.description: Use this skill for creating urban music covers featuring warm-toned portraits with glowing outer halos and metallic emblem logos.
triggerTerms: warm sepia portrait with orange glow

recipe.visualDefinition: A dual-portrait composition characterized by warm, sepia-toned lighting, a distinct orange-yellow outer glow around the subjects, and a prominent metallic crown emblem in the upper corner.
coreVisualRelationships: Metallic emblem anchored in the top-left corner
Warm subject lighting against a cool, dark background
coreInvariants: Orange-yellow outer glow around the main subjects
Metallic silver crown with spherical tips

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two male subjects in close-up; one centered and forward, the second slightly behind and to the right wearing a hat.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The metallic crown emblem in the top-left quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the bright emblem down to the central face, then right to the second face, ending at the bottom text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, textured background with subtle blue-purple shadows.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm sepia and deep browns for skin and clothing.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cool dark blues and purples in the background.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant orange-yellow for the subject halos.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between bright facial highlights and deep shadows.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Condensed sans-serif and heavy block serif
letterConstructionRules: Bottom text is ultra-condensed with vertical stretching
Logo text uses heavy block serifs with metallic gradients
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters in the logo are encased in a shield-like border
Bottom text features a subtle drop shadow for legibility
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy metallic display type paired with ultra-condensed lowercase sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the condensed, heavy feel of the bottom text.
Provides the heavy slab-serif skeleton for the logo.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of two men in 90s urban attire with warm sepia lighting and a vibrant orange outer glow against a dark blue background. Leave the top-left and bottom-center areas clear for graphics.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a metallic silver crown emblem in the top-left with beveled block text inside a shield. Add ultra-condensed lowercase text across the bottom with a silver gradient and black outline.

verificationChecks: Is there a distinct orange halo around the subjects?
Is the logo text beveled and metallic?
Is the bottom text lowercase and vertically stretched?

adjustableVariables: Number of points on the crown
mustRedesign: Identifiable facial features of the original artists
postGenerationChecks: Check for metallic sheen on the crown
Ensure the orange glow doesn't bleed into the background too much
Verify the bottom text is condensed and lowercase
Confirm the dual-portrait composition is maintained
recipe.reuseFormula: Warm Sepia Portrait + Orange Halo + Metallic Crown Emblem + Condensed Lowercase Typography
